source_name: CBCG — Mapa sajta (site map)
why_relevant: Full CBCG sitemap: the cheapest exhaustive way to discover every register, list and locale path variant (/me/, /eng/, /r/, /c/) without guessing URLs. Essential given the observed duplicate and misspelled register URLs.

source_name: CBCG — Pružaoci finansijskih usluga (non-bank financial service providers)
why_relevant: Index of CBCG-supervised non-bank providers: leasing companies, factoring, purchase-of-receivables firms, microcredit financial institutions and credit guarantee funds. Expands the licensed-actor map beyond banks/PIs into adjacent lending and BNPL-like players.

source_name: CBCG — Registar banaka (bank register, incl. historical/deregistered entities)
why_relevant: Canonical actor list for building the archive hunt: each current and former bank name/domain becomes a Wayback CDX target. Dead banks (merged/liquidated) are precisely the ones whose vendor evidence exists only in archives.

source_name: CBCG — Mikrokreditne finansijske institucije (MFI list)
why_relevant: Named list of licensed microcredit financial institutions — a distinct buyer segment for lending/collections/digital onboarding technology, absent from bank and PI registers. Note both spellings appear in CBCG URLs ('institucije' and a misspelled 'insitucije' variant), so both paths should be crawled.

source_name: Hipotekarna banka / Lovćen banka / Prva banka / Universal Capital Bank / Adriatic Bank / Ziraat Bank Montenegro — domestic private-bank sites
why_relevant: CBCG's 'Banke u Crnoj Gori' link list is the authoritative roster for building the buyer actor map of this cell. These domestically-owned banks have no group sourcing portal above them, so any tender they run surfaces only on their own site, in press oglasi, or by direct invitation — making the roster the crawl seed for the whole indirect route.

source_name: CBCG — Korisni linkovi: državne institucije
why_relevant: CBCG's own curated link list of Montenegrin state institutions — an efficient, regulator-vetted way to snowball to further register-owning bodies (ministries, agencies, supervisors) that keyword search may miss.

entity_name: Uprava za javne nabavke / Direktorat za politiku javnih nabavki
source_name: Uprava/Direktorat za politiku javnih nabavki — ujn.gov.me (incl. EU tenderi)
why_relevant: Policy authority; hosts an 'EU tenderi' category and the legal framework (Zakon o javnim nabavkama) that determines which Montenegrin entities are obligated buyers — i.e. defines the boundary this cell is built around, and points to appeal-body decisions naming vendors.

source_name: MANS institutional profile of the Procurement Rights Protection Commission
why_relevant: NGO watchdog page describing the Commission's mandate, caseload statistics and reporting; useful as a pointer to annual reports, FOI (slobodan pristup informacijama) routes and to MANS' own procurement investigations that often name suppliers.

source_name: EBRD corporate consultancy contract awards lists (annual PDFs)
why_relevant: Annual PDF lists of consultancy contracts awarded by EBRD itself reveal which advisory firms EBRD repeatedly uses for financial-sector assignments in the Western Balkans; useful for competitor/partner mapping even when the assignment country is aggregated.

source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore — tender information services (incl. NATO tenderi)
why_relevant: The Chamber of Economy runs tender-information services for Montenegrin companies, including a registry of firms eligible for NATO tenders and guidance on eligibility verification. Useful for the actor map (which local IT/integrator firms are pre-qualified for regulated buying) and as a channel where B2B procurement bulletins circulate.

source_name: UBCG - Udruženje banaka Crne Gore (Association of Montenegrin Banks)
why_relevant: Industry association whose member directory carries each bank's address, phone and official website — a clean, maintained pointer set for the buyer-side panel. Associations also host conferences and publish member communications, which is where joint technology initiatives (instant payments, cards, AML tooling) tend to be described collectively.

source_name: ASEE — Company contacts (Podgorica office entry)
why_relevant: Confirms a physical ASEE legal entity in Montenegro (Serdara Jola Piletića 3A, Podgorica; cg_office@asseco-see.me), which enables cross-linking to the Montenegro company registry (CRPS) for financials and to public procurement records — an entity-resolution anchor for the competitor map.

source_name: CRPS — Registar stvarnih vlasnika (beneficial ownership register)
why_relevant: Beneficial-ownership register established at CRPS on 1 Aug 2021 under the AML/CFT law. Critical for resolving who actually controls ME payment institutions, e-money issuers and IT vendors — often foreign parents that connect ME actors to regional group strategies.

source_name: ICT Cortex (ME ICT cluster) — bridge between regional vendors and ME banking demand
why_relevant: Montenegrin ICT cluster publishing analysis of fintech/banking transformation and listing member firms, many of which are subcontractors or local arms of regional integrators — a way to map who actually delivers regional vendors' ME work.

source_name: ICT Cortex cluster - Montenegro ICT company member directory
why_relevant: The single best actor-map pointer for this cell: a curated directory of ~37 Montenegrin ICT companies with links, including the finance-relevant ones (Cikom, Logate, PayTen, 2BI, POS4, Financial Solutions, Amplitudo, Codeus, Domen, VG Group, ZZI, Euro Unit). Snowballing this list produces most of the candidate vendor universe for ME.

entity_name: Odbor za vansudsko rješavanje potrošačkih sporova
source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore — Portal javnih nabavki page
why_relevant: Chamber of Commerce signposting page for public procurement; useful pointer to procurement rules, business-side guidance and to which member companies position themselves as suppliers to the state. Snowball source for supplier names and sector associations (ICT grouping).

entity_name: Odbor za vansudsko rješavanje potrošačkih sporova
source_name: Privredna komora Crne Gore — business directory of foreign-owned IT subsidiaries
why_relevant: Chamber-of-commerce member records reveal which regional integrators actually maintain a Montenegrin legal vehicle (vs. serving ME purely from Belgrade/Zagreb), giving a defensible list of who is present on the ground.

entity_name: Odbor za vansudsko rješavanje potrošačkih sporova
source_name: privrednakomora.me — legacy PKCG site (organizational-structure and publications archive)
why_relevant: The older chamber domain still exposes paginated, date-filtered listings of all sectoral associations and an archive of publications that the new komora.me design has partly buried — useful for historical board composition and past events.

source_name: Montenegrin Foreign Investors Council (MFIC) - member profiles
why_relevant: MFIC member profile pages carry unusually specific operational detail on foreign-owned vendors in ME - the Payten profile is where the ME-specific figures (28 staff, 6 service centres, 500+ ATMs, 13,000+ POS delivered, 9 of 11 banks) surfaced. A pointer to further foreign vendors active in ME banking/payments.

source_name: Wayback Machine / Internet Archive snapshots of ME event sponsor pages
why_relevant: Event sites overwrite the sponsor and speaker pages every edition, destroying the year-over-year series this cell depends on. The archive is the only way to reconstruct historical sponsor tiers for INFINTECH, IT SPOT and Spark.me and to date when a vendor first entered the ME market.

source_name: Conference LinkedIn / Facebook pages (INFINTECH, IT SPOT, Privredna komora, Digitalizuj.Me)
why_relevant: Event social pages publish sponsor-logo announcements, booth photos and speaker cards that never make it onto the event website, and comment threads reveal exhibitor staff. Frequently the only surviving record of past-edition sponsor rosters once the site is rebuilt for the new year.

source_name: Halcom — 'List of banks that are using Halcom' support page
why_relevant: A vendor-published, bank-by-bank client list — effectively a free installed-base map for e-banking/digital-signature in the region. If Montenegrin banks appear, it is direct named-client competitor evidence; if not, that absence is itself informative.

source_name: poslovni adresar (posao.crna.gora.me) - Montenegro business directory
why_relevant: sr-language ME business directory that surfaced the Comtrade Podgorica entity. Useful for enumerating small ME IT/POS-service firms that have no discoverable website and therefore never appear in English search.

entity_name: Ahrefs competitor listings for Montenegrin news domains
source_name: Ahrefs competitor listings for Montenegrin news domains
why_relevant: Traffic-competitor listings for pobjeda.me and standard.co.me enumerate peer Montenegrin news domains by audience overlap — a mechanical way to discover sr-language outlets this cell has not yet inventoried, independent of what search engines surface.

source_name: ecommerce4all.me — Montenegro e-payment module (CEFTA/Chamber of Economy platform)
why_relevant: Semi-official guide (Chamber of Economy of Montenegro + CEFTA project) explaining ME online payment processing, acquirers and regulation, with downloadable guide PDFs — an excellent starting map of the local PSP ecosystem and terminology.

entity_name: Entrust / global technology partner directories listing Asseco and regional partners
source_name: Entrust / global technology partner directories listing Asseco and regional partners
why_relevant: Partner directories of global card/security/ATM vendors reveal which regional (RS/HR/BA) firms hold reseller or implementation rights for the Adriatic territory including Montenegro — mapping the indirect channel that covers ME.

source_name: eUprava Crne Gore — e-government service catalogue (registration services)
why_relevant: The national e-government service catalogue documents which authority owns which register and what the registration/licensing procedure is (e.g. entrepreneur registration, insurance-market services). It is the map of register ownership, useful when a register moves between institutions.

entity_name: ICT Cortex profile on European Cluster Collaboration Platform
source_name: ICT Cortex profile on European Cluster Collaboration Platform
why_relevant: EU-maintained structured profile of the cluster (size, sectors, partnerships, EU projects) — a stable, machine-friendly cross-check on cluster claims and a route to EU-funded project consortia involving Montenegrin IT firms.

source_name: Institut sertifikovanih računovođa Crne Gore (ICAM) - register of audit firms and licensed auditors
why_relevant: Authoritative actor map of the ~37 audit firms licensed in Montenegro (Deloitte DOO, Ernst & Young Montenegro DOO, PricewaterhouseCoopers DOO, BDO, Crowe MNE, HLB Mont Audit, TPA, Baker-Tilly-type mid-tier, etc.). Anchors which advisers can sign bank audits and therefore who sits inside bank IT/controls reviews.

source_name: Mastercard Montenegro — Banke prihvatioci (acquiring banks list)
why_relevant: Scheme-published roster of which ME banks are licensed acquirers — a compact, authoritative pointer to the full acquiring competitive set, snowballable into each bank's merchant pages.

source_name: PaymentProviders.io — Montenegro country directory
why_relevant: Aggregator listing providers claiming ME coverage; thin but useful as a snowball seed to discover PSP names not surfaced by local search.

source_name: PRAVOSUDJE.me — judiciary portal (cross-court decision search)
why_relevant: Umbrella judiciary portal linking all Montenegrin courts' decision pages; the entry point for locating the Administrative Court (Upravni sud) rulings that review procurement-commission decisions — the appeal-of-the-appeal layer.

source_name: TechBehemoths - IT companies in Podgorica directory
why_relevant: Third-party aggregated directory of ME IT companies with self-declared service lines and client counts. Weak on accuracy but broad on coverage - useful to catch small integrators absent from ICT Cortex and MFIC.

source_name: Visa Partner Directory (Visa Ready certified partners)
why_relevant: Searchable directory of Visa-certified technology partners by capability and market. Certification status is a proxy for who is technically able to serve ME issuers/acquirers, and the directory itself is a pointer to vendor entities to profile.

source_name: Wikipedia — Ministry of Public Administration, Digital Society and Media (Montenegro)
why_relevant: Tracks the ministry's repeated renaming/merging (MJU / MJUDDM / current form), which is the main reason older digital-agenda documents and their URLs go dead. Gives the alias list needed to search archives correctly.
